name: Oxnard Town Center
description: Oxnard Town Center is a convenient shopping destination located on East Ventura Boulevard in Oxnard, California. This community center serves the local area with a variety of retail stores, services, and dining options for everyday needs. Strategically positioned to serve Ventura County residents with accessible parking and a practical shopping experience.
summary: A community-focused shopping center on East Ventura Boulevard offering convenient retail and dining options for Oxnard residents.
